name: @iflow-mcp/futureexcited-vibe-tools-mcp

tools.name: repo
tools.description: Ask questions about the repository using context-aware analysis. This tool analyzes code repositories to provide relevant, code-aware answers to questions.

withDoc.description: Optional array of document URLs to include as context

directory.description: Mandatory. The absolute path to the local directory you are currently working in. This is required to ensure the command runs in the correct project context.

tools.name: command
tools.description: Executes any supported AI command with specified options in a directory. Provides a general interface to run commands with full flexibility.

command.description: The command string to execute (e.g., 'repo "explain this"' or 'ask "what is recursion"')

directory.description: Mandatory. The absolute path to the local directory you are currently working in. This is required to ensure the command runs in the correct project context.

tools.name: ask
tools.description: Ask a question directly to an AI model. Note that this command does not include repository context by default.

withDoc.description: Optional array of document URLs to include as context

tools.name: plan
tools.description: Generate a focused implementation plan for code changes or features. Uses multiple AI models to identify relevant files and create a detailed execution plan.

query.description: The query for the implementation plan

withDoc.description: Optional array of document URLs to include as context

directory.description: Mandatory. The absolute path to the local directory you are currently working in. This is required to ensure the command runs in the correct project context.

tools.name: doc
tools.description: Generate comprehensive documentation for a code repository. Analyzes repository content and creates documentation that can be saved to a specified output file.

withDoc.description: Optional array of document URLs to include as context

directory.description: Mandatory. The absolute path to the local directory you are currently working in. This is required to ensure the command runs in the correct project context, especially if not using fromGithub.

tools.name: github
tools.description: Get information about GitHub Pull Requests or Issues. Retrieves either the most recent 10 items or a specific one by number.

directory.description: Mandatory. The absolute path to the local directory you are currently working in. This is required to ensure the command runs in the correct project context, especially if fromGithub is not specified or refers to the current repo.

tools.name: web_search
tools.description: Search the web for real-time information about any topic. Use this tool when you need up-to-date information that might not be available in your training data, or when you need to verify current facts. The search results will include relevant snippets and URLs from web pages. This is particularly useful for questions about current events, technology updates, or any topic that requires recent information.

search_term.description: The search term to look up on the web. Be specific and include relevant keywords for better results. For technical queries, include version numbers or dates if relevant.

provider.description: Optional AI provider to use (perplexity, gemini, modelbox, or openrouter)

tools.name: youtube_analysis
tools.description: Analyze YouTube videos to extract insights, summaries, transcripts, or implementation plans. Requires a valid YouTube URL. Use this tool when you need to understand video content, create summaries, or convert video tutorials into actionable plans.

youtube_url.description: The YouTube video URL to analyze

question.description: Optional specific question about the video

analysis_type.description: Type of analysis to perform (default: summary)

directory.description: Mandatory. The absolute path to the local directory you are currently working in. This is required to ensure the command runs in the correct project context.

tools.name: browser_automation
tools.description: Automate browser operations for testing, data extraction, or interactions with web pages. Supports multiple modes: 'open' (load a page), 'act' (perform actions), 'observe' (identify interactive elements), and 'extract' (get data from a page).

url.description: URL to navigate to, or 'current' to use existing page, or 'reload-current' to refresh existing page

instruction.description: Natural language instruction for 'act', 'observe', or 'extract' modes

console.description: Capture browser console logs (enabled by default)

html.description: Capture page HTML content (disabled by default)

screenshot.description: Save a screenshot of the page to the specified file path

headless.description: Run browser in headless mode (default: true)

no_headless.description: Show browser UI (non-headless mode) for debugging

connect_to.description: Connect to existing Chrome instance. Special values: 'current', 'reload-current'

video.description: Save a video recording to the specified directory

evaluate.description: JavaScript code to execute in the browser before the main command

directory.description: Mandatory. The absolute path to the local directory you are currently working in. This is required to ensure the command runs in the correct project context.

tools.name: mcp
tools.description: Interact with MCP servers through vibe-tools. Use 'search' to find available MCP servers or 'run' to execute MCP server tools using natural language queries.

subcommand.description: The MCP subcommand to execute: 'run' or 'search'

directory.description: Mandatory. The absolute path to the local directory you are currently working in. This is required to ensure the command runs in the correct project context.
